title: Your key never leaves your phone.
slide_intent: Explain a stopped request so a person can tell what was at stake, whether anything moved and what they can do next.
strategic_value: The blocked state shows what a protective intervention looks like when an unknown app asks for funds.
demonstration: Watch shows a request for all USDC, no covering key and no signature. The screen illustrates the blocked outcome. Key-storage location is a headline claim beyond what this screen establishes.
practical_value: Use this panel to specify the information a user needs after an intervention, including who asked, what was at stake and what they can do next.

content_islands.name: Headline field
content_islands.spec: Use a pale blue-gray ground, a black headline broken after “never”, and the line “Watch stops anything no key covers.”

content_islands.name: Intervention card
content_islands.spec: Inside a centered black-rimmed phone, set Watch as the navigation title. Use a dark rounded card with a shield, a stopped-event identifier, “An unknown app asked to move all your USDC.” and “No key covers it. Watch stopped it.”

content_islands.name: Event details
content_islands.spec: In a white four-row block, pair Asked by, Wanted, Key and Signed with “Unknown app”, “All your USDC”, “None covers it” and “Nothing”.

content_islands.name: Follow-up action
content_islands.spec: Finish the main content with a dark pill labeled “Block this app”. Leave quiet space between this button and the partially cropped bottom navigation.
